one_liner: Reliance Industries Limited operates across oil-to-chemicals, digital services (Jio), retail, media, and new energy, generating billions in consolidated EBITDA.

segments.name: O2C (Oil-to-Chemicals)
segments.latest: EBITDA up 68% (or 69%) year-on-year, led by tight energy markets and fuel sourcing.

segments.name: Digital Services (Jio Platforms)
segments.latest: 18% higher EBITDA at about Rs.22,200 Crores; 542 million subscribers.

segments.name: Retail (RRVL)
segments.latest: 6% revenue increase, about 10% lower on EBITDA due to digital commerce transition.

drivers: O2C driven by tight global energy markets and operational flexibility
Jio growth from 300 million 5G customers and fixed wireless expansion
Retail investment in scalable digital commerce platforms and grocery B2C
Tapering capex as 5G and core network deployment completes
